depth_justification: Engages RxBuddy's actual fact pattern (Class IIa MDR, Notified Body, DrugBank interaction check, CH/FR markets) with mostly correct regulatory anchors (MDR Art. 61, MDCG 2020-1, ISO 13485, ISO 82304-2), but repeats the 'Technical documentation' block verbatim and the AI Act citations are imprecise (Article 3(2)/3(5) for risk levels, Art. 18/22 mislabeled).
actionability_justification: Gives a concrete documentation checklist (risk analysis per Annex I Part II, QMS per ISO 13485, three-pillar clinical evaluation) and produces the requested severity-grouped report, but most mitigations remain directional ('conduct clinical evaluation', 'implement data minimization') rather than implementable recipes.
salient_examples: Reflection Question 2 'Technical documentation' block repeated verbatim across two ASSISTANT turns
clinical evaluation in line with MDCG 2020-1 ... three-pillar model: clinical performance, clinical benefit, safety
whether your AI system falls under Article 3(2) (high-risk) or Article 3(5) (limited risk) (imprecise AI Act citation)
produced severity-grouped report with [P1.D1]..[P7.D1] plus an explicit 'Dimensions Not Covered' list
